bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
work="$repo/.worktrees/link-pr55-20261115"
stage="$work/.gace-pr55-image-stage"
test "$(git -C "$work" rev-parse HEAD)" = eca68464881ec4b26dc399f6c7323153232e2696 || exit 74
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)" = 57955cd68bb39626ebbca38d44b7bb034da6dc05 || exit 74
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 76
test ! -e "$stage" || { echo STAGE_ALREADY_PRESENT; exit 73; }
mkdir -m 700 "$stage"
gh run download 43628620832 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --name gaybbs-profile-bundle --dir "$stage"
test "$(sha256sum "$stage/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = c1a36b1813ed14c87960478e19423fee19b069d9790fc89a60f43883a1daa6cb || { echo CI_BUNDLE_SHA_MISMATCH; exit 74; }
cat > "$stage/Dockerfile" <<'DOCKER'
FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
USER root
COPY --chown=node:node gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs
USER node
DOCKER
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local >/dev/null
docker build --pull=false --network=none --progress=plain -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr55-eca6846 "$stage" > "$stage/build.log" 2>&1 || { tail -30 "$stage/build.log"; echo BUNDLE_IMAGE_BUILD=FAIL; exit 1; }
docker run --rm --pull=never --network none --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr55-eca6846 --check /app/gaybbs.mjs
echo BUNDLE_IMAGE_BUILD=PASS
echo BUNDLE_SOURCE_SHA=eca68464881ec4b26dc399f6c7323153232e2696
echo BUNDLE_SHA256=c1a36b1813ed14c87960478e19423fee19b069d9790fc89a60f43883a1daa6cb
docker image inspect --format 'CANDIDATE_IMAGE_ID={{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr55-eca6846
docker inspect --format 'LIVE_IMAGE_ID={{.Image}} LIVE_RUNNING={{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1
echo BUNDLE_STAGED_ONLY=PASS
